notes: Stored edit. built_by (the maker of Rolls-Royce's V12 engines) is a local one-valued relation (the queries ask 'which company?'). The engines are stored by name (w1) or as the parent's (w2, a rule over wholly_owned_subsidiary_of). The original 'no' answers of q0 and q1 need what the record's determinacy_why presupposes ('Rolls-Royce belongs to BMW, so not to Volkswagen'): a wholly owned subsidiary's parents are its owner and its owner's parents (firm rule), and BMW is in neither Audi's nor Volkswagen's group (firm fact, unstated in the record).

engines: the V12 engines used in the Rolls-Royce Phantom, Ghost and Cullinan
